documents.title: Claude Project Instructions
documents.description: Session-start protocol, what TubeScout is (cousin tier), ports (8503 API / 7843 UI), and the parallel-projects port table. Note: still references the legacy C:\QI\ECOSYSTEM registry path — migrated to C:\QIH\ecosystem.

documents.title: YouTube OAuth Setup Guide
documents.description: One-time 5-minute setup: create a Desktop OAuth client (youtube.readonly), drop client_secret.json into secrets/, run --login, verify with --test, and the quota math (~600 of 10,000 free units/day).

documents.title: Requirements
documents.description: Pinned dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], gradio, httpx, python-dotenv, python-docx, pydantic; google-api-python-client + auth libs (P1); youtube-transcript-api (P2).

documents.title: Start scripts
documents.description: Manual launchers for the server and the twice-daily cycle (the latter mirrors what Task Scheduler runs).

documents.title: Main Entry Point
documents.description: Starts the FastAPI API (uvicorn :8503) in a daemon thread and the Gradio status UI (:7843); UTF-8 + file logging to data/logs/tubescout.log.

documents.title: FastAPI App + News Page
documents.description: All endpoints + the server-rendered HTML pages: /health,/version,/info,/stats,/channels,/videos,/topics, channel mutations, /news,/favorites,/discover,/digest,/settings, /api/news,/api/config. Central write-guard middleware; CORS from qi_registry; tunnel-aware NEXUS link.

documents.title: Gradio Status UI
documents.description: Minimal operator console on :7843 (Status + About tabs). The real user interface is the FastAPI HTML news page.

documents.title: YouTube Data API client
documents.description: OAuth (youtube.readonly) + get_service(); list_subscriptions, get_uploads_playlists, list_recent_uploads. CLI: --login / --test.

documents.title: Sweep orchestrator
documents.description: pull_subscriptions() + run_sweep(): discover new uploads across active channels since the lookback window, retire dead playlists. CLI: --pull-subs / --organize / --sweep / --all.

documents.title: Channel organizer + reclassifier
documents.description: Keyword classifier (whole-word) + YouTube topicCategories with a specificity rank; reduced 'other' from ~450 to ~3. Respects manual topic locks.

documents.title: Transcript fetcher
documents.description: Captions-only fetch (youtube-transcript-api), favorites-first queue, randomized throttle, IPBlocked detection + multi-hour cooldown persisted in state.

documents.title: Whisper fallback (opt-in)
documents.description: yt-dlp audio download + faster-whisper local transcription for caption-less videos; off by default (whisper.enabled), live-stream/duration guards.

documents.title: Summarizer + dedup + scorer
documents.description: NEXUS /synthesize news cards (HEADLINE+SUMMARY, description fallback); Jaccard headline dedup; implement-worthiness scoring → QI Brain /api/log_feature.

documents.title: Ecosystem feeds
documents.description: scout_feed builds the curated OPML and imports it to NEXUS Scout (Kaze); recommend builds the local taste profile, reasons via NEXUS, and follows channels without subscribing.

documents.title: Cycle + drainer
documents.description: cycle.run_cycle() is the 07:00/19:00 job (sweep→reclassify→transcripts→summarize→dedup→score→scout, each _safe-wrapped); process.py drains the transcript/summary backlog in committed batches.

documents.title: Data layer + config
documents.description: SQLite (WAL, FK on, schema v1, idempotent migrations) + channel/video/sweep helpers; dotted-path config get()/set_values() over config/tubescout.json with hot reload.

documents.title: Service installer
documents.description: Registers the QI_TubeScout NSSM service via the QI_Elevate broker (AppDirectory C:\TUBESCOUT, Description set, AUTO_START).

documents.title: Runtime Config
documents.description: Ports, interests (AI/Travel/Retirement/DOAC), youtube (scopes, max_subscriptions), sweep (07:00/19:00, 14h lookback), transcripts (languages, throttle, cooldown), whisper (off), scoring (threshold 7.0, brain_autolog), dedup (0.55/72h), integration (NEXUS/Brain/Hive URLs), scout_export, and the topic keyword map.

documents.title: Secrets (gitignored)
documents.description: YouTube OAuth client + refreshable token, and optional TUBESCOUT_PAGE_TOKEN / TUBESCOUT_NEXUS_LINK_MODE env. Never committed (secrets/ is gitignored).

documents.title: Smoke tests
documents.description: Live HTTP smoke tests against :8503; whole module skips cleanly when the service is offline; contract + authed endpoints validated conditionally.

documents.title: Service / interest tools
documents.description: Idempotent NSSM service+tunnel fixer (run elevated), interest-marking helper, and session-wrap/summary helpers.

documents.title: Admin service installer
documents.description: Elevated one-shot to (re)install the QI_TubeScout service and tunnel.

documents.title: Business Documentation
documents.description: Business-facing docs for TubeScout (QI documentation convention).

documents.title: Technical & User Documentation
documents.description: Technical reference, user guide and cheatsheets folders.

documents.title: Logs, Minutes & Summaries

documents.description: Implementation log, meeting minutes and dated session summaries.

documents.description: TubeScout entry: ports 8503/7843, family_tier=cousin, integrates_with nexus/qi_brain/openclaw, exposed + consumed endpoints, QI_TubeScout + QI_TubeScoutTunnel services, QI_TubeScout_AM/_PM tasks.

documents.title: QI Service Registry (QI_TubeScout)
